# RaidR v1.1 Release Notes

RaidR v1.1 introduces full Builder Base wall upgrade automation, an in-built game launcher, complete background window input isolation, robust text-only button templates, anti-inactivity session keep-alive, and an automated bundled Tesseract OCR discovery pipeline.

### Highlights & Key Improvements
- **In-Built 1-Click Game Launcher:** Launch Clash of Clans directly through Google Play Games PC from the top navigation bar or the Run page controls.
- **Strict Background Window Input Isolation:** Clicks and scrolls now strictly target the game HWND. Completely eliminated physical cursor movements (`SetCursorPos`) and global OS wheel broadcasts (`mouse_event`) so you can freely watch YouTube or work in other apps with zero interference.
- **Text-Only Wall Action Templates:** Replaced level-dependent graphical templates with crisp text-only templates for `Upgrade More`, `Add Wall`, and `Remove Wall`. Eliminates false-negative template misses across any wall level (Level 1–10+).
- **Builder Base 5-Wall Batch Upgrader:** Upgrades walls in batches of 5 walls at a time, intelligently falling back if resources are low, and automatically confirming with payable resources.
- **Anti-Inactivity Session Keep-Alive:** Implemented strict 2-minute random zoom-in and zoom-out kinematics (`anti_inactivity_zoom`) using window-targeted messages to prevent game logout and inactivity disconnects. Safely paused during battles and troop drops.
- **Automated Bundled Tesseract Discovery:** Enhanced `configure_tesseract()` to automatically detect and bind the local repository bundle (`tesseract_bundle/tesseract.exe`) in both source and portable runs without requiring manual environment variables.
- **Standalone Builder Base Runner:** Added dedicated CLI flag `--bb-walls-only` (and `tools/run_bb_walls_only.py`) for focused, headless wall upgrading passes.
- **In-App Software Updates & Changelog Viewer:** Direct integration with GitHub releases for seamless update detection, in-place silent updater, and in-app changelog inspection.
